edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - W Prismatic Barrier is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Cosmic Radiance: 180s at rank 1, 120s at rank 3 — burst before the delayed invulnerability lands, or wait it out. - Dazzle (E) is down 16-12s by rank — trade while it's spent. - Starlight's Touch (Q) heals through chip — anti-heal cuts it.
